newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Norwood Promotional cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Norwood Promotional cut.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw Inc Friday lowered its fiscal 1997 earnings estimate for Norwood Promotional Products Inc to $1.10 a share from $1.30 because of apparently depressed margins.

-- Rodman said Norwood's second quarter earnings of $0.03 a share was in line with its estimate, but Norwood yesterday suggested that analysts lower their estimates by $0.10 to account for lower sales from its acquisition of Alpha, a maker of insulated cups.
-- Rodman said it remains neutral on the stock.
-- Norwood shares were unchanged Friday at 13-1/2.
